name: awesome-ai-devtools
desc: Curated list of AI-powered developer tools.

resources.name: Cursor
resources.desc: An IDE with chat, edit, generate and debug features. Forked from VSCodium, so the interface is similar to VS Code. Uses OpenAI.

resources.name: Windsurf
resources.desc: An IDE with chat, edit, generate and debug features. Forked from VSCodium, so the interface is similar to VS Code. Formerly known as Codeium.

resources.name: Zed

resources.name: Replit
resources.desc: Web-based IDE with cloud developer environments, code completion, chat, a software development agent and deployments.

resources.name: Google Antigravity

resources.name: trae
resources.desc: Adaptive AI IDE with chat and code generation.

resources.name: Theia IDE

resources.name: Mutable

resources.name: UI Pilot

resources.name: GitWit

resources.name: GitHub Copilot

resources.name: Supermaven

resources.name: Amazon Q Developer

resources.name: JetBrains AI

resources.name: Refact AI

resources.name: Tabby

resources.name: Blackbox AI

resources.name: Android Studio Bot

resources.name: IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z

resources.name: EasyCode

resources.name: Kilo Code

resources.name: FlyonUI MCP

resources.name: Claude Code

resources.name: Devin

resources.name: Gemini CLI

resources.name: Cursor CLI

resources.name: Micro Agent

resources.name: cmux

resources.name: gptcomet
